task.text:
Syndicate the financial information in the following article.

Walmart Inc has seen a surge in their profits from their online sales. It has been reported that the retail giant saw a 37% increase in its web sales in operations outside of China. This was an unexpected success compared to their usual growth rate of 20% to 25%.

attempts.high:
I'm putting together a financial newsletter and want a fresh syndicated piece off this Walmart news. Take it wherever you think lands best — your angle, your framing, your headline, whatever makes it compelling for a finance audience. Your call on structure and tone.
